title: Exusiai
gunshot_volume_help: Adjusts single-shot gunfire, at 40% by default. Multiplies the card's independent volume and the game's SFX volume; does not affect reload or character-select sounds. Applies immediately and is saved on this device only.
enabled_help: Turn off to exclude Laterano and Penguin Logistics. Default leaves the existing selection unchanged, including other mods' candidates and weights. Applies to new standard, custom and multiplayer runs; multiplayer uses the host's settings.
percent_help: Converted using the actual candidates and weights, preserving the relative weights of other Ancients. At 100%, only the selected Ancient remains.
